items.title: Ellen Rowe interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 2, 2024
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I think it was Fats Waller who said, “one never knows, do one?” [INTERVIEWEE] Exactly. Exactly.

ctx.x: Same here. Same here. I was going back through the family tree but I’m not sure you’re on it.
